title: The Blue Ribbon Quilt
scene: Between 2:20 and 2:40 PM, the blue ribbon quilt vanished from the display hall. The sewing room keeps a sign-in sheet by its door.

suspects.name: Beatrice Ford
suspects.testimony: I pressed fabric in the sewing room from 2:15 to 2:45 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The sewing room sign-in sheet and Isaac's view through the doorway show Beatrice alone.

suspects.name: Isaac Patel
suspects.testimony: I brewed tea at the table facing the open sewing room door from 2:15 to 2:45 PM; only Beatrice was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: Two visitors drank tea with Isaac at the hallway table from 2:15 to 2:45 PM.

suspects.name: Stella Hayes
suspects.testimony: I arranged folding chairs right outside the display hall from 2:20 to 2:40 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The hall custodian helped Stella line up chairs outside the display hall from 2:20 to 2:40 PM.

suspects.name: Luke Meyer
suspects.testimony: I was in the sewing room with Beatrice from 2:15 to 2:45 PM, helping her sort thread spools.
suspects.contradiction: Isaac saw Beatrice alone in the sewing room, and the folded quilt was hidden in Luke's trunk.
